scope: Automatic same-heap cooperative scheduling of resumable Lisp functions; promise waits, cancellation and cleanup. Not a Bordeaux Threads backend or full McCLIM verification.

implementation.scheduler: FIFO runnable queue, checkpoint slices and explicit yields, finite slices/time per host turn via setTimeout. Completed/failed tasks retire; callers can join completion promises carrying multiple-value arrays.
implementation.wait: SYSTEM::%RESUMABLE-AWAIT emits an await request; promise fulfillment resumes a value, rejection throws through suspended Lisp.
implementation.cancellation: Invalidate old wait version and throw on next slice. Cleanup may yield/await. Self-cancellation is preserved. Unknown or malformed host requests are delivered through the generator for cleanup.
implementation.entryPoints: Explicit scheduler.spawn(function,args) JS API; existing ordinary EVAL and application entry points do not automatically become asynchronous.

kernel.scope: 64native-generator tasks, FIFO fairness and host-event progress, isolated bindings, promise fulfill/reject, cancelled obsolete wait versus newer cleanup wait, self-cancellation, unsupported/malformed requests and cleanup.

lisp.scope: Actual dual-compiled Lisp closures, same shared Lisp array with disjoint per-task cells, per-task special bindings, multiple values, generated checkpoints without explicit yield, await and cleanup that awaits. No lock-free shared read-modify-write counter claim.

node.command: npm --prefix tests run build:resumable && npm --prefix tests run test:resumable

browser.scope: Load and supplied API assertions; GUI verification is separate

browserReproduction: Concatenate performance/resumable.lisp, resumable/checks.lisp, resumable/callbacks.lisp, resumable/scheduler.lisp, resumable/alexandria-checks.lisp. Pass to probe.mjs alexandria REPORT CHECKS --browser valtan-resumable --after-load=AFTER. AFTER contains scheduler-checks.mjs plus an awaited call to verifyScheduledLisp(globalThis.valtanSchedulerKernel, globalThis.valtanScheduledTestSetup()). Probe awaits this module and hashes it.

ordinaryMode.command: npm --prefix tests run build:performance && node tests/performance/verify.mjs

limitations: No locks, condition variables or Bordeaux Threads adapter.
Ordinary top-level EVAL/load/application entry points remain synchronous; asynchronous thread joins require integration at entry boundaries.
A single blocking native operation can exceed the scheduler turn budget; scheduling is cooperative, not a hard real-time guarantee.
Cancelling an await ignores its eventual completion but does not abort the underlying host promise.
Native error delivery and arbitrary foreign callbacks are not generally resumable.
Ongoing full McCLIM dual build and old Drei jobs predate this scheduler; not counted as scheduler verification.
